means: Constructed replays, one per drawn node of shiwehi.com's 山岳積み2号 route page: our own piece queue and key inputs, run from an empty board through the vendored Triangle engine, ending on the page's drawn board. Not a game anyone played and not corpus data.
not_eligible_because: not a game anyone played; not corpus data
one engine, no second implementation of the boards

caveat.order: Where the page does not fix the piece order, the order here is ours: the first piece of each of the page's before-pairs first (bag 1: J before Z, one of the page's two example conditions), then IOTSZJL, the T into the U slot last. order_reading records it per bag.
caveat.hold: bag1.l_hold holds its L when it arrives (our choice of where: just before the bag's Z). The hold box is then never empty again: the held L comes out at its slot in bag 2 (2.normal#3, the 4-line PCs), swapped for the piece that bag places last. No other demo holds.
caveat.early: The page's bag-1 condition is an example (%J>%Z or %L%S early) that its next sentence widens; the demo uses J before Z.
caveat.chain: The PC patterns and later boards hang under the page's after-the-spin illustrations; their demos run through the demo that ends on that board (2.normal#1 for the three 通常形 forms, form 1 for each 5巡パフェ pair).
caveat.spin: Every T-spin kind and line count is the engine's verdict on the replayed inputs.

board.coords: y-UP: row 0 is the bottom row
